==Skin Upgrades==
The '''Warden''' has seventeen skins in total. This includes:
#The Default skin.
#Six skins that can be unlocked from [[Crates]].
#One skin that can be unlocked from a [[Badges|badge]].
#Five skins that can be unlocked from [[Passes]].
#One skin that can be unlocked from [[Crates]] and [[Passes]].
#One skin that can only be bought from the [[Daily Store#Daily Skin Store|Daily Skin Store]].
#One skin that can be unlocked upon triumphing an event map or completing a [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]].
#One skin that can be unlocked by completing a [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]].

==Skin Trivia==
*The '''Warden''' seems to be based on the [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Jeremy Fitzgerald|Night Guard]] from ''[[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Five Nights at Freddy's|Five Nights at Freddy's 2]]'', although he does not wield a baton.
*The {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} skin is based on [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:William Afton|William Afton]], the main antagonist from the ''Five Nights at Freddy's'' franchise. More accurately, it appears to be a depiction of his "purple guy" appearance.
**The name of the skin is most likely a reference to [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/the-man-behind-the-slaughter The Man Behind the Slaughter] meme.
**The door that this skin uses as a shield is a reference to security doors in the first ''Five Nights at Freddy's'' game.
*Interestingly, the render for the {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} skin which appears in the [[Gift Box]] depicts the Level 1 {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} '''Warden''' with the shield and axe only the Level 4 {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} '''Warden''' has.
*The critical swing sound for the Default, {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} and {{Color|Premium|Baseball}} skins is taken from ''Team Fortress 2''. 
**The {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} skin changes it to quack sounds.
*The robot animal head the Level 4 {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} '''Warden''' has is [[Wox the Fox]]'s endoskeleton head.
*The bear head the Level 3 {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} '''Warden''' wears is based on [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Shadow Freddy|Shadow Freddy's]] head from the game ''Five Nights at Freddy's.''
*On the render seen in the [[Gift Box]] after purchasing the ''Unwavering Tides Bundle'' [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] and on the gamepass itself, the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Warden''' has a different appearance Level 4 than the one in-game.
**Most notably, the render has the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Warden''' wear a black and blue jacket and hat, however, in-game they are actually white and blue.
**In the render the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Warden''' appears to have a tan skin color, while in-game it has a dark skin color.
***This difference is not present in the trailer and thumbnail for the [[v1.8.4|Unwavering Tides Update]], where it has dark skin, despite both also using wrong appearances for the skins.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Galactic}} skin appearance is based on [[w:c:starwars:Stormtrooper|Stormtroopers]] from ''Star Wars''.
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Isaac}} skin is based on [https://www.roblox.com/users/63238912/profile CEOofIsaac].
**The mask at Level 4 is based on [https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Snivy_(Pokémon) Snivy], Isaac's old mascot.
*The {{Color|Korblox|Korblox}} skin is based on the [[w:c:Roblox:Korblox's Empire|Korblox's Empire]], a Roblox medieval fantasy group.
*The {{Color|Hexscape|Freddy}} skin is based on [[wp:Freddy Krueger|Freddy Krueger]] from the ''Nightmare on the Elm Street'' franchise.
*The {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}} skin is based on [[Sir Hopsalot]], an enemy from the [[Spring 2020 Event]].<ref>[[File:EggDemomanBunnyWardenInspiration.png]]<br/>https://x.com/LinxtheDev/status/2040173550435291372</ref>
*The {{Color|Patriotic}} skin is a reference to [[wp:Captain America|Captain America]] from ''Marvel''.
